summary: fractal-web renders the selected agent conversation with the shared kit transcript and per-conversation SyncLine

replay.detail: Read-only presentation of retained conversation observations; no runtime replay change.

compatibility.detail: All nine conversation item variants and SDK sync verdicts are passed unchanged to the kit. Unavailable and earlier-history boundaries use kit EmptyState and Note; the transcript remains read-only and keeps the kit's existing empty copy. The kit does not yet expose message send-state presentation.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
